notes.title: Release of COSMIC HOLES DEMO
notes.notes: To celebrate the release of the demo version of COSMIC HOLES, a 30% discount on the full game is available from June 5, 2023 to June 12, 2023.

notes.title: April 23, 2023 Update Notes.
notes.notes:
minor fix about the 3 save slots.


To thank you for your feedback, the little green has concocted a guided tour of his world:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MLjrL-ywScc

notes.title: March 21, 2023 Update Notes.
notes.notes:
minor fix about sentinels, in the case of catch-ups (following 3 leaves on the ground) or pressing the X key.
